# LatamJobs API — Full Documentation

> A unified job board API for Latin America. Computrabajo + Bumeran + OCC + ZonaJobs + Laborum in one call.

## Detailed endpoint reference

### GET /v1/search

Search jobs across all configured portals.

**Query parameters:**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| q | string | yes | — | Search keyword (title, skill, company name) |
| country | string | no | all | Comma-separated ISO 2-letter codes: mx, co, ar, cl, pe, uy, br |
| salary_min | number | no | — | Minimum monthly salary in USD |
| salary_max | number | no | — | Maximum monthly salary in USD |
| limit | integer | no | 20 | Max results (1-100) |
| offset | integer | no | 0 | Pagination offset |
| posted_within | integer | no | 30 | Only jobs posted within N days |
| remote | boolean | no | false | Only remote jobs |
| seniority | string | no | — | Filter: junior, mid, senior, lead |

**Headers:**

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
Accept: application/json
```

**Response 200:**

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "id": "ct_abc123",
      "title": "Senior Backend Engineer (Python)",
      "company": "Mercado Libre",
      "location": "Ciudad de México, MX",
      "country_code": "mx",
      "remote": false,
      "seniority": "senior",
      "salary": {
        "min": 85000,
        "max": 130000,
        "currency": "MXN",
        "period": "monthly",
        "raw": "$85,000 - $130,000 MXN mensuales"
      },
      "description_snippet": "Mercado Libre busca ingeniero backend senior...",
      "requirements": ["Python", "Django", "PostgreSQL", "AWS"],
      "posted_at": "2026-09-19T14:22:00Z",
      "sources": ["computrabajo"],
      "urls": {
        "computrabajo": "https://www.computrabajo.com.mx/oferta-de-trabajo/..."
      },
      "hash": "sha256:abc123..."
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total": 1247,
    "fetched_ms": 3120,
    "cached": false,
    "sources_queried": ["computrabajo", "bumeran", "occ"]
  }
}
```

**Response 4xx:**

```json
{
  "error": "rate_limit_exceeded",
  "detail": "Free tier: 500 calls/month. Upgrade at https://latam-jobs-api.vercel.app/#pricing",
  "reset_at": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

```json
{
  "error": "invalid_parameter",
  "detail": "country 'xx' not supported. Supported: mx, co, ar, cl, pe, uy, br"
}
```

### POST /v1/webhooks

Subscribe to a webhook for new postings matching a query.

**Request:**

```json
{
  "url": "https://your-app.com/webhook",
  "query": {
    "q": "senior python",
    "country": "mx,co"
  },
  "events": ["job.new", "job.removed"]
}
```

**Response 201:**

```json
{
  "id": "wh_abc123",
  "url": "https://your-app.com/webhook",
  "secret": "whsec_...",
  "created_at": "2026-09-20T10:00:00Z"
}
```

**Webhook payload:**

```json
{
  "event": "job.new",
  "subscription_id": "wh_abc123",
  "timestamp": "2026-09-20T10:15:00Z",
  "data": { /* same shape as /v1/search result */ }
}
```

Verify the webhook signature:

```
X-Signature-256: sha256=<hmac(secret, body)>
```

### GET /v1/jobs/:id

Fetch full job detail. Same shape as a single result from /v1/search, with full description.

### GET /v1/stats

Public stats (no auth):

```json
{
  "total_jobs_indexed": 145230,
  "last_update": "2026-09-20T10:14:00Z",
  "sources_active": 6,
  "sources": {
    "computrabajo": { "country_count": 19, "jobs_indexed": 98234 },
    "bumeran": { "country_count": 3, "jobs_indexed": 28453 },
    "occ": { "country_count": 1, "jobs_indexed": 12045 },
    "zonajobs": { "country_count": 1, "jobs_indexed": 4500 },
    "laborum": { "country_count": 1, "jobs_indexed": 1500 },
    "elempleo": { "country_count": 1, "jobs_indexed": 498 }
  }
}
```

## Code examples

### JavaScript / TypeScript

```typescript
const response = await fetch(
  "https://api.latam-jobs.dev/v1/search?q=python&country=mx,co",
  {
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.LATAM_JOBS_API_KEY}`,
    },
  }
);
const data = await response.json();
console.log(data.results);
```

### Python

```python
import os, requests
r = requests.get(
    "https://api.latam-jobs.dev/v1/search",
    params={"q": "python", "country": "mx,co"},
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['LATAM_JOBS_API_KEY']}"},
    timeout=10,
)
r.raise_for_status()
for job in r.json()["results"]:
    print(job["title"], "-", job["company"])
```

### cURL

```bash
curl -G https://api.latam-jobs.dev/v1/search \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $LATAM_JOBS_API_KEY" \
  --data-urlencode "q=senior python" \
  --data-urlencode "country=mx,co,ar"
```

### OpenAI function calling

```json
{
  "type": "function",
  "function": {
    "name": "search_latam_jobs",
    "description": "Search job postings across LATAM (Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru, Uruguay). Returns salary-normalized deduplicated postings.",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "query": { "type": "string", "description": "Job title, skill, or company" },
        "country": { "type": "string", "description": "Comma-separated ISO codes: mx,co,ar,cl,pe,uy" },
        "salary_min": { "type": "number", "description": "Minimum USD salary" },
        "limit": { "type": "number", "description": "Max results (default 20)" }
      },
      "required": ["query"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Anthropic MCP / Claude tool use

Same schema as OpenAI function calling. LatamJobs API works as a Claude tool.

## Architecture

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  CLIENT (your app · ATS · AI agent · spreadsheet · cron)                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              │
                              ▼  GET /v1/search · Authorization: Bearer
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  EDGE  (Vercel Edge Functions · 12 regions · 0 cold start)             │
│  · auth · rate limit · response shaping · cache layer (30s TTL)        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
              │                          │                          │
              ▼                          ▼                          ▼
┌────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────┐
│  scraper/ct        │    │  scraper/bm        │    │  scraper/occ        │
│ Playwright · cron  │    │  HTTP fetch · cron │    │  HTTP fetch · cron │
│ 19 países          │    │  AR · MX · CL       │    │  MX                 │
└────────────────────┘    └────────────────────┘    └────────────────────┘
              │                          │                          │
              └────────────┬─────────────┴────────────┬─────────────┘
                           ▼                          ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  POSTGRES (Neon)                                                         │
│  · raw postings · dedup index · salary parser · keyword watchlist       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## FAQ

**Where does the data come from?** Scraping public job boards. When a board exposes an official API, we use that.

**Update frequency?** Every 15-30 minutes per source.

**How is dedup done?** Hash of (normalized_title + company + city + country). Same job in 2 portals → 1 row with `sources: [both]`.

**Can I cancel anytime?** Yes. No annual contracts. Founding price stays as long as your subscription is active.

**What if a portal changes its HTML?** Our monitoring catches it. Typical fix: 1-4 hours, deploys without action from you.
